description: Cultural Models for Assessing Impacts of Stormwater on the Aaran's Pond Community is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brooke Page, University of South Florida (usf.edu). Aaran's Pond is a local stormwater retention pond in the University Area community, and it is an important feature of green infrastructure designed to control flooding by managing rainfall runoff over impervious surfaces, such as roads and parking lots. Coverage: Aaran's Pond, University Area community (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 1 top-level file (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-7vss-jn13. Keywords: Green infrastructure, Environmental justice, Community identity. Published 2025-08-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
